name: Apple VM Duo
subtitle: Windows 11 and Arch Linux virtual machines for iPhone Duo
description: Unsigned builds of Apple VM (Duo edition): WindowsiOS with AppleVM's 3D graphics, settings and Arch Linux installer, adapted for the foldable iPhone Duo. Free software under GPL-2.0-or-later; source at https://github.com/zhouchenh/WindowsiOS (branch duo). You need your own licensed copy of Windows 11.

apps.name: Apple VM Duo
apps.subtitle: Windows 11 ARM64 and Arch Linux VMs with a JIT and GPU acceleration
apps.localizedDescription: Runs Windows 11 ARM64 and Arch Linux virtual machines on iPhone and iPad with an ARM64-to-ARM64 JIT (enable JIT with StikDebug or a Mac on every launch) and virtio-gpu 3D. Built for the foldable iPhone Duo (iPhone19,4); also runs on other devices with iOS 17 or later. The IPA is unsigned: SideStore or AltStore signs it with your Apple account. get-task-allow is required to enable JIT. Increased Memory Limit (paid developer accounts) lets the guest use more RAM.
